newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 18.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on December 18:
MOSCOW - Six Red Cross workers were killed in their beds in a hospital in Chechnya by unknown assailants, the deadliest single attack ever on Red Cross employees.

KINSHASA, Zaire - By the thousands, throngs of singing Zairians swarmed through the stinking, decaying international airport terminal and spilled onto the tarmac to welcome President Mobutu Sese Seko.

WASHINGTON - Investigators hired by President Clinton's legal defence fund suspected that many contributions collected by a Clinton friend this year were phony because the purported donors appeared unable to afford $1,000 gifts.

WASHINGTON - First Lady Hillary Rodham Clinton is taking a more active role in the District of Columbia and its problems, raising money for a new D.C. after-school program and agreeing to donate some of the profits from the sale of her book to a local children's hospital.
WASHINGTON - The trademark rights for President Clinton's inaugural emblem, an imposing logo resplendent with an eagle and the Capitol, has been claimed by a Republican.
